Introduction.one: How the guidelines are organised, and the basic rules that apply to every registration.

pts: Only registered pesticides may be used, and only as per the label claim
Data must follow test guidelines and GLP; submit complete study reports
Technical must be registered before, or together with, any FI / FIM registration
9(3B) data need not be resubmitted for 9(3) by the same applicant if composition and claims are unchanged
Type: chemical, microbial, botanical or pheromone
Material: technical, formulation or MUP; and formulation type (solid, liquid, vapour)
Category: 9(3B) provisional, 9(3) regular or 9(4) me-too
Purpose: domestic use, export, or both; and the label claims
1 General · 2 Export & import · 3 Chemical pesticides (agriculture)
4 Biopesticides · 5 Household, public health, aircraft, ectoparasites

1.1 KYC on CROP portal.one: The Know-Your-Company form every registrant fills on the CROP portal; once active, common legal documents need not be resubmitted with each application.
nums: KYC to be updated every year (or earlier, after audit approval)

pts: Policy & practices · Plant & machinery · QC equipment · Land & buildings
Financial · Compliance (licences, PCB, fire NOC, insurance) · Registrations · Production
Give information manufacturing-site-wise; leave no question blank
Reply Y / N; number every attached document as shown in the format
Write the company site name on each page
No need to resubmit BOD resolution, licence, PAN, incorporation certificate, site ownership proof, 3-year product list

watch: Misleading or fake information is liable for prosecution

1.2 Inclusion of pesticide in the Insect.one: What to submit to get a new pesticide added to the Schedule of the Insecticides Act (CIB, 22nd meeting, 1992).

pts: Common name and chemical name of the pesticide
Literature support on chemistry, bio-efficacy and toxicity
Registration status in other countries

1.2 Infrastructure - botanical biopestic.one: Minimum manpower, rooms and equipment a botanical biopesticide manufacturer must have (297th RC, 2009).

pts: A Quality Control Biologist, plus staff for production, maintenance and stores
Extraction, production, formulation, packing & storage rooms and a QC lab
Protective clothing, respiratory devices, first aid, waste disposal as per pollution norms
Plant: separation vessels, decanter, mixers, centrifuge, Soxhlet, filling and sealing machines
Lab: HPLC, pH meter, spectrophotometer, microscope, autoclave, flash-point apparatus, TLC

watch: These are minimums; more may be needed for specific products and production volume

1.3 Infrastructure - Baculoviruses (NPV,.one: Minimum manpower, rooms and equipment for manufacturers of NPV and GV baculovirus products (297th RC, 2009).

pts: A Quality Control Biologist, plus supervisory staff
Culture, moth oviposition and production rooms with temperature and humidity control
Diet preparation room, virus processing lab, QC lab, formulation unit, cold storage
Diet mixer and dispenser, BOD incubator, centrifuges, haemocytometer
Research and zoom microscopes, autoclave, humidifiers, oviposition cages

watch: Minimums only; scale up for specific products and production volume

1.4 Infrastructure - microbial biopestic.one: Minimum manpower, rooms and equipment for manufacturers of microbial biopesticides: antagonistic and entomopathogenic fungi and bacteria (297th RC, 2009).

pts: A Quality Control Biologist, plus supervisory staff
Fungi: production, mixing & drying room and formulation unit
Bacteria: inoculation, fermentor & sterilisation room and formulation unit
Packaging & storage room and a QC lab
Plant: fermentor / bioreactor, steam boiler, chilling plant, RO plant, sealing machines
Lab: autoclave, laminar flow, BOD incubator, deep freezer, microscope, colony counter

watch: Minimums only; scale up for specific products and production volume

1.5 Infrastructure - pesticide manufactu.one: Minimum infrastructure a chemical pesticide manufacturer needs before the State Licensing Authority issues a manufacturing licence (261st RC, 2006).

pts: Technical plant: reactors, centrifuge, drier, phase separator, extractor, tanks, colour-coded pipelines
Formulation plant: equipment differs for solids (DP, WG, SP) and liquids (EC, EW, SL)
Analytical balance, pH meter, spectrophotometer, GLC / HPLC as per the product specification
Fume hood, flash-point and melting-point apparatus, BIS specification of the product
Filling, weighing, bagging, sealing and labelling machines

watch: Also required under the Rules: medical facilities, protective clothing, respiratory devices, safety training and safe disposal

1.6 Endorsement of additional manufactur.one: Conditions for adding a second manufacturing site (abroad) to an existing registration; toll manufacturing is a separate matter (325th RC, 2012).
nums: batches analysed: original site and new site
minimum validity of samples and reference standards

pts: The new site must belong to the same registrant; no third-party premises
The registrant must hold registration for the same product in that country
All operations at the new site must be run by the same registrant (undertaking certified by that country's DNA)
Consent letters from the approved source and the new site, certified by the DNA
Declaration that same technical, raw materials and process are used
5-batch analysis reports from both sites, plus samples and reference standards for CIL testing
DNA-certified documents supporting the new site (e.g. ICAMA for China)
Justification for the additional site
Inform CIB of every consignment from the new site: port of entry and expected arrival date

watch: Failing any condition lets the RC reject the application, or cancel the endorsement if already granted

1.7 Enhancement of shelf life u/s 9(4).one: How a 9(4) registrant can get the longer shelf life already granted to another registrant of the identical product (284th RC, 2007).

pts: Your registration details, with notarized supporting documents
That shelf life was already enhanced for another registrant's product (give its registration status)
Chemical composition identical to that product (side-by-side comparison)
Primary packaging identical to that product's approved packaging
Use the application proforma with verification, signed and sealed

watch: If any information is found incorrect, the enhancement can be withdrawn without notice
